thread:
nora: Postmortem published: short summary - control-plane publish race caused an overlapping prefix to be announced during a rolling maint. Low DNS TTLs (~25s) and aggressive client reconnects amplified into a TLS handshake retry storm impacting inter-region traffic (sa-east-1 -> eu-west-1). Full doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248765.

cal: saw the TLS spike on the dashboards, SYN_RECV and SYN retransmits on the LBs matched the timeframe.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-099 created; paging history attached. Alerts auto-suppressed while mitigations applied. :white_check_mark:

net-eng-ana: triage notes: 1) publish race created overlapping announce for 10.0.0.0/21 covering existing 10.0.4.0/22 2) clients re-resolved quickly due to TTL=25s 3) some gateways hit conntrack soft thresholds causing SYN drops -> retries -> TLS alerts.

devops-sam: immediate mitigations applied: paused rolling maint at 04:22 UTC, quarantined the shadowed prefix at 04:25 UTC, and bumped DNS TTL for impacted records to 900s at 04:28 UTC. Observing metrics now.

nora: agreed action items: A) add publish-guard to reject overlapping prefixes unless explicit override (owner: anya, ETA: 4d, JIRA NET-510) B) default TTL floor for multi-region services to 120s (owner: net-eng-ana, ETA: 72h, JIRA NET-511) C) conntrack autoscale + alert tuning (owner: devops-sam, ETA: 7d, JIRA INFRA-824) D) TLS handshake canary with src-region breakdown and reflector tag (owner: cal, ETA: 48h, OBS-260) E) runbook update for planned maintenance with explicit publish-lock step (owner: nora, ETA: 3d).

anya: starting PR for publish-guard now: https://git.redwood/routing/PR-629 - adds dry-run, admin-override, and a safety check comparing intended prefix against active announces. reviewers: @cal @net-eng-ana.

cal: opened OBS ticket OBS-260 for canary panels. will include per-src-region and per-reflector id.

net-eng-ana: will schedule the TTL default rollout after approvals; emergency bump validated via dig and resolver logs.

devops-sam: INFRA-824 created and initial plan attached. will run conntrack scaling test Friday and post results.

nora: I'm adding a recurring-incident tag and entry on the networking board: pattern = control-plane race + low-ttl -> TLS retry storms. also adding a checkbox to postmortem template: "any recent rolling maint or publish operations?"

cal: quick note for runbooks: include a one-command rollback for prefix quarantine and a verification checklist (dig + curl + lb metrics). will draft.

anya: PR posted, tests pass in staging. will request reviews.

sre-bot: Follow-ups created: NET-510, NET-511, INFRA-824, OBS-260, OPS-137.

nora: thanks all. I'll create the tracker card and assign owners. please update JIRAs/PRs as you make progress. closing this thread unless blockers surface. :sparkles:
